description: Expected results for the official TELEMAC-MASCARET example telemac2d/gouttedo (water drop in a square basin), main sequential run t2d_gouttedo.cas. The official check (vnv_gouttedo.py: check_epsilons('seq:T2DRES', 'f2d_gouttedo.slf', eps=[1e-7])) compares every variable of the last record against the official reference file f2d_gouttedo.slf with an absolute max-norm tolerance of 1e-7. The ref_* values below are read FROM that official reference file and use the same 1e-7 tolerance. The run_* mass-balance values come from our own run (no official value exists for them).
engine_version: TELEMAC-MASCARET 9.1-dev (main branch, commit be14a12315ac9346ca0ce8da065aba5d0ec5766e, 2026-03-26), build main_gfortran_release, serial

recorded_with: run_reference.py through the KI tool tools/run_telemac.py (telemac2d.py, serial) with /mnt/disk1/Hydrocraft_server/python_env/bin/python; two runs gave bit-identical result files
reference: examples/telemac2d/gouttedo/f2d_gouttedo.slf (Git LFS, sha256 051a9303afab21bf0d458a7282781f33e09984bc178d7bbed9d5d980b3a31521) and vnv_gouttedo.py, TELEMAC-MASCARET repo https://gitlab.pam-retd.fr/otm/telemac-mascaret commit be14a123
notes: Observed on 2026-10-05: largest difference to the official reference over all records and variables was 5.7e-14 (last record: 0.0). Run-only tweak: run_reference.py makes an empty folder <workdir>/user_fortran/CMakeFiles/user_fortran.dir in the temp run dir before the run, because this build's user-Fortran link command writes a linker dependency file there. No input file or setting is changed; the result matches the official reference.
